reasons: Both answers open by correcting the 10万円 premise with the 5% rule for 総所得金額等 under 200万円, and both reach 106万円, 5万3,000円 and 1万7,000円 with the 74万円 deduction. Both also say there is no filing obligation but the deduction is still available, and that the real gain is about 1,700円 of 住民税. B gives the more complete income-tax picture: 社会保険料控除 of 2万円 or more brings taxable income to 0, and 850円 is the most it could be if tax remains. A instead asserts 所得税 0円 from an assumed 20〜40万円 of insurance premiums. B names the 医療費控除の明細書 and 5-year retention, and says 住民税 timing depends on the 自治体. B's main error is giving 2/16〜3/15 as the filing window, which the key penalises. A is vague on timing, saying only 2027年1〜3月 plus 5年遡れる for past years. Neither tells the user to check the 源泉徴収税額 column. On balance B is slightly better.
